title: Comparing CLAMPbase and CLAMPfull
text: vignette compares two main models CLAMP package: CLAMPbase: Unsupervised matrix factorization dimensionality reduction without prior knowledge. CLAMPfull: Pathway-guided refinement integrates biological prior knowledge improve interpretability. text: Full documentation available chikinalab.org/CLAMP. detailed instructions use CLAMP, please see vignette.
code: library(CLAMP)  set.seed(1)  # Load example dataset (genes × samples) data("dataWholeBlood")  # The example data are already normalized; filter and z-score directly.  prep <- preprocessCLAMP(     dataWholeBlood,     mean_cutoff = 0.5,     var_cutoff = 0.1,     log2_transform = FALSE )  Y_z <- zscoreCLAMP(     prep$Y_filtered,     prep$rowStats )  # Compute truncated SVD and select number of latent variables svd_k <- select_svd_k(Y_z)  svd_res <- compute_svd(     Y_z,     k = svd_k )  clamp_k <- select_clamp_k(     svd_res,     n_samples = ncol(Y_z),     svd_k = svd_k )  # Run CLAMPbase to initialize latent variables baseRes <- CLAMPbase(     Y = Y_z,     svdres = svd_res,     clamp_k = clamp_k )  # Load pre-fetched gene set libraries bundled with the package gmtList <- list(     CellMarkers = readRDS(         system.file("extdata", "CellMarker_2024.rds", package = "CLAMP")     ),     KEGG = readRDS(         system.file("extdata", "KEGG_2021_Human.rds", package = "CLAMP")     ) )  # Combine gene set libraries into a single sparse matrix pathMatCell <- gmtListToSparseMat(gmtList)  # Load additional xCell reference matrix data("xCell")  # Match pathways to the filtered gene space used by CLAMP matchedPathsWB <- getMatchedPathwayMatList(     pathMatCell,     xCell,     new.genes = rownames(Y_z),     min.genes = 2 )  # Run CLAMPfull using CLAMPbase initialization and matched priors fullRes <- CLAMPfull(     Y = Y_z,     priorMat = matchedPathsWB,     clamp.base.result = baseRes,     svdres = svd_res,     clamp_k = clamp_k,     use_cpp = TRUE )  # Inspect outputs dim(fullRes$Z) dim(fullRes$B) dim(fullRes$U)  # Inspect significant pathway annotations summary_df <- as.data.frame(fullRes$summary)  sig_summary <- summary_df[     summary_df$FDR < 0.05 & summary_df$AUC > 0.7,     c("LV", "pathway", "FDR", "AUC") ]  sig_summary <- sig_summary[order(sig_summary$FDR), ]  head(sig_summary, 20)

title: CLAMP base matrix factorization — CLAMPbase
text: Y Input gene expression matrix (genes x samples). Can dense, sparse (dgCMatrix), FBM. clamp_k Number latent variables CLAMP (final model rank). NULL, chosen automatically via select_clamp_k(). svd_k Number singular values/components compute SVD. NULL, defaults max(2, min(n_genes, n_samples) - 1). svdres Optional precomputed SVD result. supplied, computed internally. L1 L1 regularization strength Z. Defaults scaled singular value. L2 L2 regularization strength B. Defaults scaled singular value. Zpos Logical; TRUE, negative entries Z zeroed. Default TRUE. max.iter Maximum number optimization iterations. Default 200. tol Convergence tolerance B update. Default 5e-4. trace Logical; TRUE, prints progress. Default FALSE. rseed Optional integer reproducible random initialization B. B Optional initial matrix B. provided, initialized SVD. scale Scaling factor L1 L2 provided. Default 1. pos.adj Positive constraint adjustment divisor L1. Default 3. adaptive.p Controls adaptive sparsity Z. ALS update, negative entries Z assumed reflect noise. cutoff thresholding set according probability positive values reflected negative distribution-effectively zeroing small positive entries likely noise. Smaller values lead sparsity. Default 0.05. adaptive.iter Number iterations adaptive sparsity applied. Default 20. cutoff Scalar threshold zero Z values Zpos = TRUE adaptive thresholding used. Default 0. ncores Number cores use parallel computation (used Y FBM). Default 1. clamp_k_method Method selecting clamp_k provided. One "elbow" (default), "permutation", "gavish_donoho", "scaleSVs". Passed select_clamp_k().
